ja.description:
VRM 拡張は解釈しない素の glTF として読む。GLB(自己完結) が確実。
スキンメッシュはバインドポーズ(T ポーズ)で読まれる。ボーンアニメの再生には
別途アニメ機構が要る(現状はモデル自身のアニメ再生は未対応。姿勢固定の小物/
地形/建物や、TJS 側でトランスフォームを動かす用途向け)。

tr.description:
Loads files as plain glTF without interpreting VRM extensions. GLB (self-contained) is the most reliable.
Skinned meshes are loaded in their bind pose (T-pose). Playing bone animations requires a separate animation mechanism (the model's own animations cannot currently be played back; this loader is meant for props, terrain and buildings with fixed poses, or for moving transforms from TJS).

ja.summary: OS パスから (.gltf+外部リソースも解決可) -> GLTFModel

tr.summary: Loads from an OS path (.gltf with external resources can also be resolved) -> GLTFModel

ja.summary: 吉里吉里ストレージ名から (GLB 推奨) -> GLTFModel

tr.summary: Loads from a Kirikiri storage name (GLB recommended) -> GLTFModel
